summary: ArgoCDDeploy's chart now authors D7 notifications to Alertmanager (both triggers, alertmanager-bodied templates, a selector-free global subscription), D9 SSO as direct OIDC to Keycloak with dex retired and local admin kept as break-glass, and three ExternalSecrets carrying the webhook secret, the OIDC client secret and one repo-creds entry for https://github.com/pvginkel/ — nothing secret committed, since argocd-cm and argocd-secret hold $<secret>:<key> references Argo resolves out of part-of=argocd Secrets.
